invariants: each quantified, modal, counterfactual, relation and association layer remains typed in the runtime goal
modal or counterfactual content is never lowered to ordinary factual ExistsGoal
UNKNOWN remains open-world uncertainty and is not treated as false
goal compilation and inference perform no canonical writes
quantified association selects at least one explicitly bound endpoint
